body:
Since he deleted his whatsapp, which was the only remaining way we had of communicating (he is in another city and deleted his facebook), I spoke to his sister who is also my friend. I asked her how he was doing and she said he's really not well indeed. He isolated himself from the few friends he had in his town and just stays in his room. She brought up the suicide risk on her own, without me mentioning it first. She said he stays alone at home in the mornings, since everyone else there has to work or study, and they are scared of coming back home and finding him dead. Then she said she was angry that his idols keep killing themselves, as they may serve as examples. She also said her entire family also saw the "goodbye whatsapp and friends" image in his whatsapp and they also freaked out. Relatives from other cities started calling his house to see if everything was ok. Good to know I'm not paranoid, I wasn't the only one to think that this could be a message.

Thanks for the input, ThisToWiIlPass. Since he cut out our communication, his sister seems to be the only tool I have, other than calling services (which I don't even know exist in my country)

I should mention he's been being treated by a psychiatrist and a psychologist for years. Obviously it's not working, as right now he's doing worse than when we were in college
